name: global-messenger
description: Private, realtime messaging for web and Android with one-to-one and group chats, media sharing, calling, notifications, and user-controlled conversation history.

scripts.dev:server: npm run doctor && node scripts/upgrade-auth.mjs && npm --prefix apps/server run dev
scripts.dev:web: npm run doctor && node scripts/upgrade-auth.mjs && npm --prefix apps/web run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --strictPort
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
